input.sparql:
SELECT ?ahu ?zone ?zoneName ?sensor WHERE {
  ?ahu rdfs:label ?ahuLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?ahuLabel, "AHU03"))
  ?ahu brick:serves ?zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?zoneName .
  ?sensor brick:isPointOf ?zone .
  ?sensor rdf:type brick:Air_Temperature_Sensor .
}

SELECT ?vav ?zone ?zoneLabel ?sensor WHERE {
  <http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#AHU03> brick:feeds ?vav .
  ?vav brick:serves ?zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?zoneLabel .
  ?sensor brick:isPointOf ?zone .
  ?sensor rdf:type brick:Air_Temperature_Sensor .
}
